import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants (strip spaces, correct case variants)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().replace({' Adelie': 'Adelie', 'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm values (take absolute value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g values (keep only within 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Remove duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Filter for Adelie penguins only
    adelie_df = df[df['species'] == 'Adelie']
    
    # Group by island and compute average bill length
    result = adelie_df.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean().to_dict()
    
    return result
